# KeyResultIcon

<!-- description:start -->
Displays the icon for a Tracker key result entity. Renders a fixed SVG asset wrapped in a sized container, with a built-in tooltip that shows the localized "Key result" label on hover.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {KeyResultIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<KeyResultIcon />
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * Size of the SVG icon inside the container in pixels.
     * @default 16
     */
    size?: number;

    /**
     * Size of the icon container in pixels.
     * @default 24
     */
    refugeSize?: number;
}
```
<!-- props:end -->

---

## Examples

### Default

```tsx
import {KeyResultIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

<KeyResultIcon />
```

### Custom size

```tsx
// Larger icon for a header row
<KeyResultIcon size={20} refugeSize={32} />
```

### Alongside key result name

```tsx
import {KeyResultIcon} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

export const KeyResultLabel = ({name}: {name: string}) => (
    <div style={{display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8}}>
        <KeyResultIcon />
        <span>{name}</span>
    </div>
);
```

---

## Notes

- The tooltip text is **automatically localized** using the Gravity UI `getConfig().lang` setting. No additional i18n setup is required.
- Unlike [`GoalIcon`](../GoalIcon/README.md), [`ProjectIcon`](../ProjectIcon/README.md), and [`PortfolioIcon`](../PortfolioIcon/README.md), `KeyResultIcon` does **not** accept an entity ID — it always renders the same fixed asset.
- To render the correct icon for an arbitrary meta entity type, use [`MetaEntityIcon`](../MetaEntityIcon/README.md) instead.
